amendments.note: reauction_baseline fix after trial 11: its ReAuction now also re-announces a dead robot's task another survivor has already re-opened (CLAUDE_CODE/06 'two peers both re-auction -> idempotent (task seq)'), so every survivor sends its own newer round; before it, the first announcer could wait for another robot's round (56.6 s at 0 pct loss, run 6ea3bef9). The 6 baseline attempts run before the fix are kept in runs_baseline_superseded.csv (all attempts: runs_before_baseline_fix.csv) and were re-run; the PARAKRAM trials (lease mode: award-gate code path, unchanged) are kept.

task-layer fix after the first full pass: two awards of ONE auction round (two announcers that missed each other under loss) persisted when the winning Award message was lost (run a548032c, 40 pct: both robots worked on task_001 for 77 s). The award announcer now rides on renewal intents (Intent.task_announcer, from TaskProgress.announcer_id) and digests (TaskDigest.award_announcers), so the lower announcer wins within one delivery; a new award waits award_settle = 1 s before it is worked on. Lease mode (award gate) only: the reauction_baseline code path is unchanged, its trials are kept. The 43 PARAKRAM attempts of the first pass are kept in runs_parakram_superseded.csv (all attempts: runs_before_task_tie_fix.csv) and PARAKRAM was re-run.
